name: The Hellp
description: '''The Hellp''' is an [[electronic music]] duo based in [[Los Angeles|Los Angeles, California]], consisting of [[Noah Dillon]] and Chandler Lucy. The band released their debut album ''Twin Sinner'' in 2016, followed by numerous [[extended play]]s and singles. In 2024, their sophomore album ''[[LL (album)|LL]]'' was released on [[Atlantic Records]]. Their third album ''[[Riviera (The Hellp album)|Riviera]]'' was released in November 2025. The group is associated with the [[indie sleaze revival]] of the 2020s, though they reject the label.
